notes.title: Huge list of features!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As the first update I wanted to address some of the missing content the community (more specifically the reviews) asked for! So here it is the huuge list:

[list]
[*][b]Record tracking and display[/b]: On every match you match we will compare the score with your previous record and store that for reference
[*][b]Day/night mode[/b]: If you play for a long time the background sky will start to get darker
[*][b]Match time count and display[/b]: You can now check how long the match is lasting, this information will be useful on a future update
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]: If you have trouble to understand the game mechanics on the start of every match now you can check how everything works
[*][b]Variable rising speed[/b]: to make it more challenging the ladder will present different rising speeds
[*][b]Levels![/b] Each level increases the rising speed a bit
[*][b]Fullscreen mode (on/off)[/b]: For those who enjoys playing on windowed mode too
[*][b]Exit button[/b]: To quickly leave the game
[*][b]Pause[/b]: No need to explain these
[*][b]Camera shake effects[/b]: To make it more "juicy"
[*][b]Mouse over HUD effects[/b]: Improving the UX
[*][b]New mouse cursor[/b]: Easier to see during the match
[*]And much more!
[/list]

Hope you enjoy! More updates soon!
